## Type of contribution

- [ ] Level 1 — new/updated model profile (`devices/`), no code
- [ ] Level 2 — Lua device handler (`plugins/lua/`)
- [ ] Level 3 — new Python protocol adapter (`translator/adapters/`)
- [ ] Protocol mapping / documentation only
- [ ] Test fixtures only
- [ ] **Hardware validation of an existing untested model** (hugely welcome)
- [ ] Firmware compatibility report
- [ ] Core / framework change
- [ ] Documentation

## Privacy and sanitization

- [ ] **No credentials anywhere** — no tokens, device secrets, local keys,
      cloud passwords, certificates or API keys, in code, fixtures, logs,
      screenshots or this PR text
- [ ] No full MAC addresses (OUI only), no real IPs (RFC 5737 instead)
- [ ] No serial numbers, device IDs, account identifiers or SSIDs
- [ ] I only captured traffic on my own network and my own devices
- [ ] I ran a search for leaked values over everything I am adding

**What I removed or replaced:**

## Licensing and provenance

- [ ] I am licensing this contribution under **MIT** (inbound = outbound)
- [ ] I have the right to contribute it
- [ ] No code, comments or captured fixtures copied from another project
- [ ] If my protocol knowledge came from someone else's work, I implemented it
      independently and recorded it in `source_provenance` / `notes`

**Where my protocol knowledge came from:**

## Safety

- [ ] This change does not modify appliance firmware
- [ ] This change does not attempt to defeat TLS or extract private keys
- [ ] My plugin declares `permissions` as all `"none"`
- [ ] My plugin is `enabled_by_default: false`
- [ ] My plugin does not request or receive credentials
